name: 16 Colors Diamond Rose Crystal Touch Lamp | USB Rechargeable Bedside Lamp with Remote
description:
Add elegance and charm to your space with the Diamond Rose Crystal Touch Lamp. Made from premium acrylic, it sparkles like a diamond and casts a rose-shaped shadow for a luxurious, romantic vibe. With 16 color options, touch control, and remote operation, it’s perfect for bedrooms, living rooms, cafes, or as a gift. The USB rechargeable battery ensures up to 12 hours of illumination, making it ideal for both indoor and outdoor use.
Key Features:
 Elegant diamond-cut rose crystal acrylic design
 16 colors with touch & remote control
 Rechargeable battery with up to 12 hours use
 Creates romantic rose-shaped shadow effect
 Suitable for bedrooms, living rooms, cafes & more
 Perfect as decor, night lamp, or gift
How to Use:
 Charge the lamp fully with USB cable
 Use touch sensor or remote to change color/brightness
 Place on bedside, table, or decor area
 Recharge after 4–5 hours of use
Material:
High-Quality Acrylic, LED Light Components
Safety Information:
 Do not expose to water or extreme heat
 Use only the provided USB cable for charging
 Keep away from small children when in use
 Avoid dropping to prevent damage
Package Includes:
 1 × Diamond Rose Crystal Touch Lamp
 1 × Remote Control
 1 × USB Charging Cable
